text: Nope, not doing that. That's not what I asked. Like I literally just told you, I want it on my credit card. That's the original payment method. That's what I said. Can I just talk to someone who can actually fix this?
zh: 不，我不这么干。那不是我问的。就像我刚才告诉你的，我想退到我的信用卡上。那是原始支付方式。那就是我说的。我能直接和能实际解决这个问题的人说话吗？
